title: 第9章  楚南死了
content_zh:
楚山看着楚弛离去的背影，眼神睿智。
他知道，楚弛可能没说实话，但这不重要，每个人都有自己的秘密。
如果楚弛真的是天才，他绝对会当成重点培养对象。
但光是武道天赋高，还不够，修者最重要的，还是修为！
毕竟，强大的武技，需要修为去支撑。
楚弛回到院子后，亲自做了一顿饭。
吃饱喝足后，他盘腿而坐，开始吸收天地灵气。
不知道是荒古大日体，还是《大道自然诀》的原因，四周的灵气，居然主动朝楚弛汇聚而去。
似乎他将整个村子的灵气，都聚集在了这里。
他丹田里的灵气，在快速变得饱和。
只要灵气饱和，他就可以试着冲击第四条隐脉。
一旦打通，修为就提升到了凡人境四层。
“差不多了！”
八个小时后，楚弛睁开了眼睛！
他体内的灵气，已经饱和。这速度，快到爆啊！
要知道，吸收天地灵气来提升修为，是非常慢的。
普通人提升一层修为，短则三五年，长则十来年。
也就是说，他的天赋，的确很牛逼。
“哈哈，没想到速度这么快，这么说，现在就可以冲击第四条隐脉了。但听说冲击隐脉，需要淬体晶辅助……”
就在楚枫轻喃的时候，院门忽然被推开。

楚弛眉头一皱，修炼被打扰，是很不爽的事情。
“八妹……你这是……”
推开房门的，正是楚盈盈。
楚盈盈额头有汗，似乎是一路奔跑而来，她着急地道：“七哥，快跑赶紧跑！”
楚弛当时就冷了：“跑？跑什么？”
“哎呀，先跑了再说，你得赶紧离开楚家，不，离开飞云村！”
楚盈盈一边说，一边推着楚弛的身体。
“这，到底什么事情，这么惊慌？”
楚盈盈咬牙道：“五哥……死了！”
楚弛瞳孔一缩：“什么？楚南死了？不可能啊，那点伤，不足以要他的命。你确定他死了？”
“我确定。刚才我去找五哥，想要安慰安慰他。但，我推开门，就看见，就看见……”
“看见什么？”
“看见五哥……吊死在了房梁上！”
“你的意思是，他自杀了？我草！这啥比是自尊心太强，还是受不得一点打击？居然自杀！我小时候，受他那么多欺负，也没有想过轻生啊！现在的人，怎么一点抗压能力都没有！”
楚弛破口大骂。
随后，他眉头一皱，觉得大事不妙。
四伯父楚寻意，只生了楚南这一个带把的！
虽然楚南不是被他杀了的，以四伯父楚寻意的性格，又岂会放过他？
尽管楚弛有镇天鼎，可用来保命。
但镇天鼎这种好东西，只有生死关头，才能用。

一旦用了，还必须得用镇天鼎，将对方砸死、杀人灭口才行。
虽然他同楚家人关系不怎样，却也没有到，要将对方弄死的地步。
楚弛强行让自己冷静下来，开口询问道。
“四伯父，知道楚南死了吗？”
“还不知道，是我先发现的尸体，我发现后，第一时间就来通知你了。”
“好妹妹！”
楚弛拍了拍楚盈盈的头。
对方，虽然不是他的亲妹妹，却胜似亲妹妹。
“既然他还不知道，那我的确应该趁这个时间先走！”
“嗯，七哥，快走吧。我送送你。”
楚弛和楚盈盈刚准备离开，一声怒吼，响彻整个院子。
“楚弛小杂种，给我滚出来，你害死我儿，我要你死！”
“不好，是四伯父！他已经知道了！七哥，你快点走，我这里有些银子，你全部带上，不要回来！”
楚盈盈将身上所有银两，都交给了楚弛。
楚弛没有收银子，而是转头看向了门口。
门口，站着一位中年，正是楚寻意，他已经到了！
楚寻意双眼血红，来势汹汹，怒气冲冲！
他的怀里，抱着楚南的尸体。
他的手里，还握着一封绝笔信，也就是遗书。
遗书上，只有一句话：爹，替我杀了楚弛，否则，我死不瞑目。

“小杂种！”
楚寻意用手指着楚弛的脸，他身上的杀意，丝毫没有遮掩！
他来这里，就是要杀楚弛！
“八妹，老爷子在不在家？”
楚弛再次开口。
楚盈盈摇了摇头道：“爷爷不在，他好像是送什么重要的货物，还没有回来。”
闻言，楚弛不再说话，他的眼神，异常冷静！
既然楚寻意执意杀他，他也不可能坐以待毙。
楚寻意是凡人境七层的修为，他们之间差了整整四层。
这差距，虽然很大。
但，他也不是一点机会都没有。
如果用剑，在出其不意的情况下，可重伤，甚至，杀死楚寻意。
楚弛去到花坛旁边，捡起了放在那里的剑。
《七剑斩》，就是他的依仗。
此时，楚寻意抱着楚南的尸体，已经来到了院子中央。
“儿啊，你在天有灵，好好看着吧。为父，这就给你报仇雪恨！”
楚寻意将楚南的尸体，放在了地上。
他，要准备杀人了！
只听嘭的一声闷响。
他的身体，像是炮弹一般，射向了楚弛。

他的拳头，发光发亮，好似一轮明日。
这是楚家唯一的人级上品武技：光明拳。
这一拳，让空气都产生了爆破。
这一拳，直击楚晨的脑袋。
这一拳，锁定了楚弛的气机，楚弛想躲也躲不了！
“居然是光明拳，四伯父，不，不要杀七哥啊……”
楚盈盈快崩溃了。
难道一天之间，她要见到两位亲人死去？
楚盈盈丝毫没发现，楚弛握剑的手，微微上扬了一下。
只等楚寻意进入他的攻击范围，他手里的剑，就会挽出五道剑光。
刀剑无眼，楚寻意可能会死。
但这不是楚弛能控制的，他的修为太弱，攻击一旦打出，就无法收回。
五步，三步……
到范围了，楚弛双眼一冷，正准备持剑攻击，一位老者出现在楚弛身前，用手挡住了楚寻意的攻击。
“木爷爷！”
看清楚老者的模样，楚弛有些惊讶。
这不是守护武技房的木爷爷吗？
“木老，怎么是你？你为什么拦我？”
楚寻意惊讶询问。
木老淡淡开口道：“楚山走的时候，特意交代我照看这小子一下。你要杀他，等楚山回来吧。算算时间，估计也快了。”

“不等，我等不了，我现在就要弄死他！”
“可以，但，你得先打败我。”
木老说着，全身释放出恐怖的气息。
这气息，是凡人境八层！
content_en:
Chu Shan looked at Chu Chi's leaving back with wise eyes.
He knew that Chu Chi might not be telling the truth, but that didn't matter. Everyone had their own secrets.
If Chu Chi is really a genius, he will definitely be a key training target.
But just having high martial arts talent is not enough. The most important thing for a cultivator is cultivation!
After all, powerful martial arts require cultivation to support them.
After Chu Chi returned to the yard, he cooked a meal himself.
After eating and drinking, he sat cross-legged and began to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
I don't know if it's the ancient sun body or the reason of the "Natural Art of the Great Dao", but the spiritual energy around him actually took the initiative to gather towards Chu Chi.
It seemed that he had gathered the spiritual energy of the entire village here.
The spiritual energy in his Dantian was quickly becoming saturated.
As long as the spiritual energy is saturated, he can try to attack the fourth hidden vein.
Once it is cleared, the cultivation level will be promoted to the fourth level of the mortal realm.
"Almost!"
Eight hours later, Chu Chi opened his eyes!
The spiritual energy in his body is already saturated. This speed is so fast!
You must know that absorbing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to improve your cultivation is very slow.
For ordinary people to advance to a higher level of cultivation, it can take as short as three to five years and as long as ten or so years.
In other words, his talent is indeed awesome.
"Haha, I didn't expect it to be so fast. So, I can hit the fourth hidden vein now. But I heard that hitting the hidden vein requires the assistance of tempering crystals..."
Just when Chu Feng was whispering, the courtyard door was suddenly pushed open.
Chu Chi frowned. It was very unpleasant to have his practice interrupted.
"Eight Sister...what are you..."
It was Chu Yingying who opened the door.
There was sweat on Chu Yingying's forehead. She seemed to be running all the way. She said anxiously: "Brother Qi, run quickly, run quickly!"
Chu Chi became cold at that moment: "Run? Why are you running?"
"Oh, run away first. You have to leave the Chu family quickly, no, leave Feiyun Village!"
Chu Yingying said while pushing Chu Chi's body.
"What on earth is going on that makes you so panicked?"
Chu Yingying gritted her teeth and said: "Fifth brother... is dead!"
Chu Chi's pupils shrank: "What? Chu Nan is dead? Impossible, those injuries are not enough to kill him. Are you sure he is dead?"
"I'm sure. Just now I went to find Brother Wu, wanting to comfort him. But when I opened the door, I saw, I saw..."
"What did you see?"
"I saw Fifth Brother... hanging from the beam!"
"You mean, he committed suicide? Damn you! Is this because he has too much self-esteem or can't bear a little blow? He actually committed suicide! When I was a child, I was bullied so much by him, but I never thought of committing suicide! People nowadays have no ability to withstand stress at all!"
Chu Chi cursed loudly.
Then, he frowned and felt that something was wrong.
The fourth uncle, Chu Xunyi, only gave birth to Chu Nan, the leading one!
Although Chu Nan was not killed by him, with the character of his fourth uncle Chu Xunyi, how could he let him go?
Although Chu Chi has a heaven-suppressing cauldron that can be used to save his life.
But a good thing like the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron can only be used in a life-or-death situation.
Once used, the Heaven-Suppressing Cauldron must be used to smash the opponent to death and kill them to silence them.
Although he didn't have a good relationship with the Chu family, he didn't want to kill each other.
Chu Chi forced himself to calm down and asked.
"Fourth uncle, do you know that Chu Nan is dead?"
"I don't know yet. I was the one who found the body first. I will notify you as soon as I find it."
"Good sister!"
Chu Chi patted Chu Yingying's head.
Although the other party is not his biological sister, she is better than his biological sister.
"Since he doesn't know yet, I should really take advantage of this time to leave first!"
"Well, Brother Qi, let's go quickly. I'll see you off."
Chu Chi and Chu Yingying were just about to leave when a roar resounded throughout the courtyard.
"Chu Chi, little bastard, get out of here, you killed my son, I want you to die!"
"No, it's fouruncle! He already knows! Brother Qi, hurry up and leave. I have some money here. Take it all with you and don’t come back! "
Chu Yingying gave all the money she had to Chu Chi.
Chu Chi did not collect the money, but turned to look at the door.
Standing at the door was a middle-aged man, none other than Chu Xunyi. He had already arrived!
Chu Xunyi's eyes were blood red, menacing and angry!
In his arms, he held Chu Nan's body.
In his hand, he also held a final letter, which was a suicide note.
There was only one sentence in the suicide note: Dad, kill Chu Chi for me, otherwise, I will never die in peace.
“Little bastard! "
Chu Xunyi pointed his finger at Chu Chi's face, and the murderous intent on his body was not concealed at all!
He came here just to kill Chu Chi!
"Bamei, is the old man at home? "
Chu Chi spoke again.
Chu Yingying shook her head and said: "Grandpa is not here, he seems to have sent some important goods and has not returned yet. "
Hearing this, Chu Chi stopped talking, his eyes were extremely calm!
Since Chu Xunyi insisted on killing him, he couldn't just sit back and wait for death.
Chu Xunyi was at the seventh level of the mortal realm, and there was a whole four levels difference between them.
This gap is huge, though.
However, he doesn't have no chance at all.
If you use a sword, you can seriously injure or even kill Chu Xunyi in an unexpected situation.
Chu Chi went to the flower bed and picked up the sword placed there.
"Seven Swordsman" is what he relies on.
At this time, Chu Xunyi had arrived at the center of the yard holding Chu Nan's body.
"Son, you have a spirit in heaven, take good care of it. As a father, I will avenge you! "
Chu Xunyi placed Chu Nan's body on the ground.
He is ready to kill!
Just heard a muffled bang.
His body shot towards Chu Chi like a cannonball.
His fist was shining like a bright sun.
This is the Chu family's only human-level high-grade martial skill: Guangming Fist.
This punch caused the air to explode.
This punch hit Chu Chen's head directly.
This punch locked Chu Chi's energy, and Chu Chi couldn't hide even if he wanted to!
"It's actually the Bright Fist, Fourth Uncle, no, don't kill Seventh Brother..."
Chu Yingying was about to collapse.
Could it be that she was going to see two relatives die in one day?
Chu Yingying didn't notice at all that Chu Chi's hand holding the sword rose slightly.
As soon as Chu Xunyi entered his attack range, the sword in his hand would emit five rays of sword light.
The sword has no eyes, and Chu Xunyi may die.
But this is beyond Chu Chi's control. His cultivation level is too weak, and once the attack is launched, it cannot be taken back.
Five steps, three steps...
When he reached the range, Chu Chi's eyes turned cold and he was about to attack with his sword. An old man appeared in front of Chu Chi and blocked Chu Xunyi's attack with his hand.
"Grandpa Mu! "
Chu Chi was a little surprised when he saw the old man's appearance clearly.
Isn't this Grandpa Mu who guards the martial arts room?
"Mulao, why is it you? Why did you stop me? "
Chu Xunyi asked in surprise.
Mu Lao said calmly: "When Chu Shan left, he specifically asked me to take care of this kid. If you want to kill him, wait until Chu Shan comes back. Calculating the time, it will probably be soon. "
"No wait, I can't wait, I want to kill him now! "
"Okay, but you have to defeat me first. "
Mu Lao said, releasing a terrifying aura from his whole body.
This aura is from the eighth level of the mortal realm!
